customer.business: Battery-backed washing machine (working name): a semi-automatic washer with a built-in battery that finishes a load during a power cut, charged from the grid when power is on or from an optional solar panel
customer.target: Rural Indian households (village and small-town) that face frequent or long power cuts and either hand-wash today or own a basic washer that stops when the power goes
customer.where: Rural India: villages and taluka/block towns, bought through local electronics dealers

segments.name: Hamlet with weak or no grid, uses a solar home system

behaviours.name: Hand-wash family
behaviours.how: Clothes are washed by hand at home, a tap or a pond; a machine has never seemed necessary.

behaviours.name: Already owns an inverter
behaviours.how: Has an inverter and battery for lights and fans during cuts, and thinks about everything in terms of what it can run.

behaviours.name: EMI buyer
behaviours.how: Buys big items on monthly instalments through the dealer or a finance company; the monthly amount matters more than the total.

behaviours.name: Asks relatives and the dealer
behaviours.how: Will not buy until a relative, neighbour or the trusted local dealer vouches for it.

behaviours.name: Festival-offer waiter
behaviours.how: Waits for Diwali, harvest season or a wedding in the family to make a big purchase, and expects a discount or free gift.

behaviours.name: Big-brand loyal
behaviours.how: Only trusts well-known brands they see on TV, because service and spare parts are available.

behaviours.name: Price-first
behaviours.how: Compares the cheapest option in the shop and walks away from anything that feels like a premium.

pitch:
A 7 kg semi-automatic washing machine with a built-in lithium battery.
When the power goes out mid-wash, it switches to the battery and finishes the load (about 2 cold-water loads per full charge).
It charges from your normal plug when power is on, or from an optional 300 W solar panel.
Price: ₹21,999 for the machine, or ₹1,999 a month for 12 months on EMI. Solar panel kit: ₹6,500 extra.
Sold and installed by your local electronics dealer; 2-year warranty on the machine, 3 years on the battery, with service at the dealer.
